title: 刀工

content_zh:
连胜向两边介绍道：“我的战友们。我的新朋友。”
鲁明远点头：“你们好, 我是鲁明远。”
三人尊敬喊了一声学长。
郑磊过来数了数：“十四只？连胜你打了几只？”
鲁明远说：“十四只。”
郑磊：“什么？”
鲁明远说：“我的子弹给她, 让她帮我打的。”
“哦, 这样啊。”郑磊说, “二十颗子弹, 十四只猎物。太厉害了。”
鲁明远认真纠正道：“不是, 是十四颗子弹，十四只猎物。我的枪之前被人抢走了，只剩下四枚子弹。”
鲁明远看着连胜, 有些崇拜道：“她真是太厉害了。”
沈喻下意识的脱口而出：“真的假的？”
郑磊撞了他一下，他才意识到自己的不礼貌，改口道：“我是说……太厉害了。”
鲁明远轻笑, 然后说了自己的遭遇, 并着力夸大连胜的贡献。
三人一时不知道该惊叹连胜的十四发全中好，还是惊叹鲁明远的传奇遭遇好。
“原来真的有这样的人。”孟江武皱眉说, “去年的时候就听说了。真是个败类。”
因为这场活动是团体计分, 队伍里少了一个人的成绩, 排名自然会大幅下降。有些人为了提升自己的成绩, 就会去找小队里武力值较弱的一人突破, 以此捣乱。可以说是相当恶劣了。
孟江武说：“你也挺倒霉的。”
“不不不, 我运气挺好的。”鲁明远摇手道，“我自己就算有十发子弹，也肯定打不到四只猎物。”
他说着顿了顿, 看向连胜问：“我真的可以拿四只吗？”
连胜：“请。”

另外三人自然没资格说什么。
连胜看他们表情, 指着鲁明远问：“你们认识他？”
“当然，听说过。”孟江武说，“模拟的时候，指挥系两个班都是要一起合作的……虽然我们一直没这个机会。”
沈喻觉得这个问题显然有些扎心，接嘴问道：“你们真是守株待兔？哪里有那么多猎物？”
鲁明远指了个方向。
沈喻惊道：“那边的草这么高，什么都看不见，你怎么打的？”
连胜：“我知道兔子在哪里。”
孟江武：“怎么知道的？”
连胜淡淡说：“经验。”
几人抿嘴。
他们真就不信，纵观整个联盟，还有哪个地方能让人磨砺打猎的经验？就算有，有谁会去做？
几人狐疑地看了她一眼，却不和连胜纠结，因为连胜太特别了。
郑磊挥了下手，示意大家先走着。于是五个人一起下山。
他们走到山脚的营地，去登记成绩。有不少人零散地站在周围张望，因为行动中小队分散了，要先汇合。
鲁明远也看了一会儿，随后有三人朝他冲了过来。
他朋友拍着他的肩，关心道：“你没事吧？到底去哪里了？我们怎么都找不到你！”
他们很早就回来了，但是两手空空，显然有些悲催。
“没事。”鲁明远提起手里的野兔，兴奋道：“看！多亏了他们，打了四只！”
双方小队，各自过去登记。
连胜一个人打了十只，他们三个加起来才打了三只，而且已经属于超常发挥。对比起来有点寒碜。兔鸭清点过后，打上标记，让他们带走。这就是他们的晚饭了。

一只都没有打到的队伍，可以用积分与他人兑换。或者透支积分向部队兑换馒头。连胜的队伍大丰收，自然被人团团围住。
吃的话，他们四个人，加上米饭，一顿饭最多的也就吃个三四只。从旧例来讲，如果小队吃的食物足够，女生的猎物会让她自己换取积分。于是孟江武让她去换，一只两分，地位瞬间腾飞。
连胜拎着看了一会儿，留下三只鸭子，把剩下的拎过去登记。让他们也把手里的换了。这样人人都有一个开门红。
郑磊都快哭了。
多么善解人意的姑娘？于是他率先同意。
一个人同意，另外两人就好意思开口。
这是他们有生以来第一次，在狩猎活动中获得额外积分。简直感天动地！
狩猎的截止时间是晚上八点。大部分人会在时限到来之前用完子弹，但也有些人会故意等到天黑，山林安静的时候，戴上夜视镜打猎。这样确实是比较容易的。
晚饭所有人都要聚集在营地周围吃。
他们捡了石头搭灶火，准备清理鸭子，鲁明远搬了一篮菜过来。
这边的菜也是要用积分换的。但是鲁明远的队伍平白拿了四只，根本吃不完。于是就用多余的换了积分，拿过来送给连胜。

content_en:
Lian Sheng introduced both sides: "My comrades. My new friends."
Lu Mingyuan nodded: "Hello, I am Lu Mingyuan."
The three of them called out to "Senior" respectfully.
Zheng Lei came over and counted: "Fourteen? How many did you hit in a winning streak?"
Lu Mingyuan said: "Fourteen."
Zheng Lei: "What?"
Lu Mingyuan said: "I gave her my bullets and asked her to shoot them for me."
"Oh, that's it." Zheng Lei said, "Twenty bullets, fourteen prey. That's amazing."
Lu Mingyuan corrected him seriously: "No, it's fourteen bullets, fourteen prey. My gun was snatched away before, and there are only four bullets left."
Lu Mingyuan looked at Lian Sheng and said with some admiration: "She is really amazing."
Shen Yu blurted out subconsciously: "Real or false?"
Zheng Lei bumped into him, and he realized his impoliteness and changed his words: "I mean... it's too awesome."
Lu Mingyuan chuckled, then talked about his own experience, and tried to exaggerate his contribution to the winning streak.
The three of them didn't know whether to marvel at the winning streak of fourteen shots, or to marvel at Lu Mingyuan's legendary encounter.
"It turns out there really is such a person." Meng Jiangwu frowned and said, "I heard about it last year. What a scum."
Because this event is a group scoring event, if one person is missing from the team, the ranking will naturally drop significantly. In order to improve their performance, some people will find someone with a weak force value in the team to break through, so as to cause trouble. It can be said to be quite bad.
Meng Jiangwu said: "You are quite unlucky too."
"No, no, no, I'm very lucky." Lu Mingyuan waved his hand, "Even if I had ten rounds of bullets, I would definitely not be able to kill four prey."
He paused as he spoke, looked at Streak and asked, "Can I really get four?"
Streak: "Please."
The other three were naturally not qualified to say anything.
Lian Sheng looked at their expressions, pointed at Lu Mingyuan and asked, "Do you know him?"
"Of course, I've heard of it." Meng Jiangwu said, "During the simulation, both classes of the command department have to work together... although we have never had this opportunity."
Shen Yu felt that this question was obviously a bit troublesome, so he asked: "Are you really just waiting for prey? Where are there so many prey?"
Lu Mingyuan pointed in a direction.
Shen Yu was surprised: "The grass over there is so high, you can't see anything, how did you fight?"
Streak: "I know where the rabbit is."
Meng Jiangwu: "How do you know?"
Lian Sheng said calmly: "Experience."
Several people pursed their lips.
They really don't believe it. Looking at the entire alliance, where else can people hone their hunting experience? Even if there were, who would do it?
A few people looked at her suspiciously, but they didn't bother with the winning streak, because the winning streak was too special.
Zheng Lei waved his hand and motioned for everyone to go ahead. So the five people went down the mountain together.
They walked to the camp at the foot of the mountain to register their results. There were many people standing around and looking around, because the team was separated during the operation and had to be reunited first.
Lu Mingyuan also watched for a while, and then three people rushed towards him.
His friend patted his shoulder and asked with concern: "Are you okay? Where have you gone? We can't find you!"
They came back early, but empty-handed and obviously a little miserable.
"It's okay." Lu Mingyuan raised the hare in his hand and said excitedly: "Look! Thanks to them, we killed four!"
Teams from both sides went over to register.
One person hit ten in a row, and the three of them combined only hit three, and they were already performing beyond their normal capabilities. It's a bit shabby in comparison. After counting the rabbits and ducks, mark them and let them take them away. This is their dinner.
Teams that haven't beaten any can use their points to exchange with others. Or overdraft points to exchange for steamed buns with the troops. The winning team had a great harvest and was naturally surrounded by people.
If they eat, theyFour people, plus rice, can only eat three or four at most in one meal. According to the old rules, if the team eats enough food, the girl's prey will let her exchange points for herself. So Meng Jiangwu asked her to change, and her status soared instantly.
Lian Sheng carried them and looked at them for a while, leaving three ducks behind and carried the rest over to register. Let them also change the ones in their hands. This way everyone gets off to a good start.
Zheng Lei almost cried.
What a considerate girl? So he was the first to agree.
When one person agrees, the other two have the nerve to speak.
For the first time in their lives, they get extra points in the hunt. It’s so moving!
The closing time for the hunt is 8 p.m. Most people will run out of bullets before the time limit comes, but some people will deliberately wait until dark and the forest is quiet to put on night vision goggles to hunt. This is indeed easier.
Everyone gathers around the camp for dinner.
They picked up stones to build a stove fire and prepared to clean the ducks. Lu Mingyuan brought a basket of vegetables over.
The dishes here also need to be exchanged for points. But Lu Mingyuan's team got four of them in vain and couldn't finish them all. So I exchanged the extra points for points and gave them to Streak.
